factual_methodology.summary: Separate Oct-14 CIT fund flows, Oct-21 money market stocks, August TIC, September gold and company AUM; follow ICI primary qualifier.

counterfactual_review.summary: Explicitly offers alternative causal interpretations, scenarios, observable tests and disconfirming evidence without categorical market forecasts.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Canonical localized titles exactly match Markdown H1; no known public-prose blockers, no Reuters sources or unsupported action recommendations.

contrary_evidence: ICI attributes the extraordinary domestic-equity outflows primarily to collective investment trusts, not widespread retail sales.
Positive ETF net issuance is already inside the combined flow statistic and cannot be counted a second time.
August TIC inflows predate October fund activity and cannot establish the destination of those withdrawals.
Gold ETF tonnage rose while market valuations fell; market value and physical quantity are not equivalent.
limitations: ICI CIT outflows do not identify ultimate liquidation, beneficial-owner relocation or final loss of wealth.
Month and week reporting periods are intentionally non-additive.
notes: Internal structural, source-identity and numerical-parity review; independent external peer review was not performed.
